title: Every bus, tram and metro train in Rome in 24 hours
description:
Every bus, tram and metro train running in Rome on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds. The feed has no FL regional trains, no Roma-Lido, Roma-Viterbo or Termini-Giardinetti trains and no Cotral buses, so they are not shown.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Rome city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Metro, Tram and ATAC bus, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 1,763 vehicles at 8:30 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable. Roma Servizi per la Mobilità starts its October timetable on October 9, so the earlier days are left out.
